title: 월요일 아침
caption:
오늘도 출근한 고양이 1화 🐱 월요일 아침

월요일엔 눈이 안 떠지는데… 간식 얘기엔 번쩍 뜨이는 거 저만 그런가요? 😼

#오늘도출근한고양이 #냥대리 #인스타툰 #직장인공감 #월요병 #고양이웹툰 #직장인툰 #공감툰

panels.scene: Monday 9 AM in a simple office cubicle, wide shot showing the office wall and a window high above. Nyang Daeri is slumped face-down on his desk next to a computer monitor, eyes closed, totally exhausted. A small wall calendar on the cubicle partition shows the word MON in big letters. Tired gloomy mood, soft morning light.

Meong Bujang bursts in energetically from the right side with a huge excited smile, one fist raised high, sparkles around him. Nyang Daeri, still at his desk on the left, lifts his head slightly with dead half-open eyes.

Close-up. Meong Bujang on the right casually holds up a plain unbranded pouch of cat treat sticks (simple pastel pouch with only a cute fish drawing, no letters). Nyang Daeri on the left suddenly opens his eyes wide, eyes sparkling with shock and excitement, ears straight up, dramatic shiny radiating background effect behind him.

dialogues.speaker: meong_bujang
dialogues.text: 아, 오늘 아침 회의 간식은 츄르야~

panels.scene: Small meeting room with a long table. Nyang Daeri sits alone in the front seat, perfectly upright with a notebook ready, eyes sparkling, super motivated. Ham Jumin peeks in through the open door on the right, looking surprised and confused.
